acceptance_criteria.statement: ExecuteApprovedProposal starts only from an approved, non-expired, exact-compatible proposal after current Workspace/resource and ExecutionAuthorizer approval; human approval alone grants no execution authority.
ExternalResourceReferenceVerifier verifies the exact approved m4r1 key, expiry, Workspace, capability version and binding before lease acquisition; every denial produces zero provider calls.

The server computes one immutable canonical-json-v1 request fingerprint over operation, exact capability/binding/reference claims and normalized title/description, paired with the proposal's immutable logical execution identity.

ToolActionStore.acquire_execution uses PostgreSQL transaction time and typed CAS to atomically create generation 1, owner/deadline, executing state, append-only audit and an AuthorizedExecutionBindingSnapshot without raw provider ID.
Concurrent execution acquisition has exactly one applied winner; losers return a typed in-progress, conflict or non-executable projection and make no provider call.
Observation and finalization require the current owner, generation and unexpired lease; stale, expired and non-owner callers are fenced and cannot win conflicting finalization.

The provider receives the immutable logical execution identity and exact stored fingerprint; same-key/same-fingerprint replays, different fingerprints conflict and concurrent calls create at most one logical side effect.
Direct provider success finalizes succeeded; only target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected are definitive failures that finalize failed and map to sanitized TOOL_PROVIDER_FAILURE.

Any outcome where external receipt is possible remains executing and returns typed ExecutionIndeterminate/HTTP 202 with the same logical identity; the deterministic before-receive case is also non-terminal and cannot authorize an immediate blind retry.

Execution actor, current authority evidence, lease generation, provider identity, immutable binding/fingerprint/logical ID, observations and outcome are reconstructable from append-only audit while M1-M3 regressions remain green.

design_decisions.decision: Proposal actor, approval actor and execution authority are distinct; ExecuteApprovedProposal revalidates current authority immediately before side effect.

Exact capability, Workspace-to-external-scope binding and policy provenance/version compatibility are checked against the immutable approved snapshot; material mismatch is stale and requires a new proposal/approval, while temporary execution denial may leave the proposal approved.
PostgreSQL owns proposal/execution lifecycle, typed lease generation, observations and audit; the SQLite reference provider owns independent external state and the authoritative idempotency ledger.
Lifecycle remains executing until a definitive provider outcome; indeterminate_external_outcome is a typed observation, not a terminal state.
Issue #77 implements direct authorized execution and provider idempotency only; stale-lease takeover, orphan recovery and ReconcileExecution are delivered by blocked Issue #78.

invariants: Authentication, Workspace/resource authorization, exact reference verification, current execution authorization and compatibility checks all precede lease acquisition/provider invocation as specified; denial paths have zero provider calls.
Capability registry remains static and typed; no plugin framework or dynamic discovery is introduced.
The approved capability version and Workspace-to-external-scope binding cannot silently retarget or upgrade at execution.
Logical execution identity and request fingerprint are server-derived, immutable and never accepted from the request body.
The reference provider's external state/idempotency ledger is independent of ToolActionStore.
Expiry blocks a new execution start; it does not redefine later Issue #78 reconciliation authority for an already-started execution.
No model or system actor can approve, and approval remains insufficient for execution authority.
Raw provider IDs, credentials and unbounded provider errors never enter public projections or audit evidence.
out_of_scope: ReconcileExecution, stale execution lease takeover and orphaned executing recovery, owned by Issue #78.
A vendor-backed production integration; the deterministic SQLite reference provider is the M4 release boundary.
Dynamic plugins, capability discovery or a general plugin framework.
Editing immutable proposals or silently reusing approval after a material capability, binding or policy change.

test_cases.statement: Exercise approved execution under authorized, revoked, cross-Workspace, expired and exact capability/binding/policy mismatch conditions with ordered counting sentinels.
test_cases.oracle: Only the currently authorized exact-compatible case acquires a lease or calls the provider; temporary denial remains approved while material mismatch is stale.

test_cases.statement: Mutate, forge, expire and cross-bind m4r1 references, including retired/revoked key cases, before execution.
test_cases.oracle: Every integrity/scope/version failure is typed and occurs before acquisition/provider calls.

test_cases.statement: Vary request-body attempts at logical ID/fingerprint and normalized title/description, then recompute canonical-json-v1 independently.
test_cases.oracle: Client identity fields are rejected/ignored per contract and the stored/provider fingerprint exactly matches the server canonical projection.

test_cases.statement: Race concurrent acquire_execution calls for one approved proposal using PostgreSQL-backed composition.
test_cases.oracle: Exactly one generation-1 winner/audit event exists; every loser is typed and produces zero provider calls.

test_cases.statement: Attempt observation/finalization with wrong owner, stale generation and expired lease, including a stale owner after a newer durable projection is visible.
test_cases.oracle: Every invalid owner/generation/deadline is ExecutionFenced and cannot alter outcome/audit.

test_cases.statement: Invoke the SQLite reference provider concurrently and repeatedly with same logical ID/same fingerprint and same logical ID/different fingerprint.
test_cases.oracle: Same fingerprint replays one stored outcome and side effect; different fingerprint returns idempotency conflict; the external ledger remains independent of PostgreSQL.

test_cases.statement: Exercise provider success and each closed definitive failure taxonomy member.
test_cases.oracle: Success finalizes succeeded; only the three approved failures finalize failed with sanitized 502 projection and reconstructable audit.

test_cases.statement: Exercise timeout, acknowledgement loss, provider unavailable, malformed/unknown response and deterministic before-provider-receive failure.
test_cases.oracle: Every case remains executing with typed 202 indeterminate projection, identical logical ID/fingerprint and no immediate blind retry.

test_cases.statement: Reload PostgreSQL execution/audit and SQLite provider ledger independently after direct outcomes and indeterminate observations.
test_cases.oracle: All required authority/binding/lease/provider/observation/outcome fields reconstruct exactly without raw provider IDs.

test_cases.statement: Run focused execution/provider/HTTP tests, complete repository pytest, Ruff, Compose and clean Alembic migration.
test_cases.oracle: All M4.3 checks and M1-M3 regressions are green on the exact candidate SHA.

command_projections.statement: Clean PostgreSQL database recreation and Alembic upgrade using the pinned Python runtime.
Focused Issue #77 tests followed by the complete repository pytest suite with worktree-pinned PYTHONPATH.
Ruff and Docker Compose configuration verification.

required_evidence.statement: Ordered authorization/reference/compatibility/acquisition/provider traces with per-path provider call counts.
PostgreSQL lease/CAS/fencing projections and append-only audit reconstruction across reload.
SQLite provider external-state/idempotency ledger rows, replay/conflict results and independent restart evidence.
Sanitized HTTP/result matrix for direct success, definitive failures and every indeterminate class, including before-receive no-blind-retry evidence.
Exact subject SHA, focused/full test totals, Ruff/Compose exits, clean Alembic head and clean worktree status.
